detail:
verdict=deploy-ready; posted and transitioned; caveats:
  - The container image ships no frontend assets (no index.html under /app), so every UI deliverable was unreachable: the View Operation button on the admin patient page, the /admin/patients/:patientUuid/operations/:operationUuid/debugger page, and the extracted DebuggerTabs with its lazy per-tab mounting were never rendered.
  - The 'Also fixed' frontend commits (leading slash on five API calls, the useFeatureFlag substring bug, the FeatureKey literal union) were therefore not exercised at all; the repo also has no frontend unit runner, so nothing covers them anywhere.
  - /api/feature-flags returns [] for demo-demo in this instance, so even the backend input that triggered the unknown-flag-id bug is absent here.
  - The case was hand-built through the admin API rather than arriving over HL7, and the demo tenant's EMR pull is synthesised from the existing operation row, so no real EMR integration was involved on either the read or the launch path.
  - The scope note holds: nothing was checked about whether the debugger tabs mutate the case once open, because the tabs never rendered.
